question: Which of the following is the fastest way to open the Help window in Microsoft Word?

options.text: Type ‘help’ in the search bar and then, press Enter
Click the Help button on the ribbon
Click the Microsoft Office button and then, click Help

solution:
The correct answer is __**Press F1**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Press F1** is the fastest way to open the Help window in Microsoft Word.
 
• The F1 key is a common standard across many software applications to bring up the help documentation or support window.
